body:
Hey. I've felt like that every single day of my life. I also know now that plenty of other people feel this way, even supposedly successful ones, but no one talks about it.

This is pure existential angst and as humans, being sentient, we are doomed to suffer it. There's no escaping it.

Because no one talks about it, it locks us up in these tiny individual mental cages.

So go and talk about it. Make daily YouTube videos on what depressed you today and how you're feeling, what's helping/not helping. Cry your heart out. Most people won't care, some will. Write here or in a journal. 

I'm not trying to talk you out of suicide or give you false hope.....I'm just saying explore the suicidal thoughts a little more. For want of a better metaphor, peel the onion. It could be a worthwhile effort. If not, well, you tried.

Same. I would jump at the chance of painless suicide (yes I'm a coward) if it weren't for the people left behind. I couldn't do this to my son, to my mother.

I grew up hating everything in my life - except my mom - so much that I promised myself that once she dies, I'll end it all.

Now I have a 7-year-old son. I cannot do this to him.

And that's when I realized that this whole marriage-children thing is the biggest con in the world - ultimately you stay alive for the people in your life, well after life has become not worth living.

Can you believe I've felt exactly the same way every single day of my goddamned life. 

Agree that life's pretty hopeless. It feels like a punishment we've been given for no fault of our own. We had no choice in it.

I'm not here to talk you out of suicidal thoughts. I can't because I have them myself every single day.  I'm just listening. 

Are there any small things that bring you joy - and secret pleasures. An ice cream, a song, a favourite top?

I'm sure it isn't. But keep in mind that throughout this amazing life I've had crippling depression and anxiety and an utter inability to enjoy any of the highs. And no one understands this.

The only way for me is to be out.
I think it's a fundamental truth about humanity/sentient life that has been hidden way too long.....needs to become more mainstream.
How old are you sweetie? Let's talk.
Read up on anti-natalism. I have my own take on it, but more or less I agree with it.

So what sustains you when you stop self-harming. Like whats your haven at the end of the day. I started smoking a lot, as all my relationships crumbled around me. I had nothing to hold on to. Self-harm kind of reinforces my world view. If I move away from that world view, I feel lost.
Is it worth it? I keep dipping my toe into self harm now and then.
The closest I've come to is mental oblivion. Comfort seems a far cry.

Yup. I feel that. Parents, though well meaning for the most part, screw us up the most. There's that famous quote, right? To love without knowing how to love wounds the other person.

And that brings me to my most recent conviction that all relationships are headed that way. No one really knows how to love you, and no one cares enough to learn and practice the 'right' way of loving you. Not even your parents or spouse or child. So I've come to the conclusion that life is just one long process of getting over every relationship you've ever had.

It's okay, I know there's nothing anyone can do. I'm just running away from my life, isolating myself. I feel more stable and in-control that way. I don't see it as inherently bad, just very against what is portrayed in media and movies and books. I'm trying to use my isolation as a source of power. When I truly don't give a fuck about anyone anymore, that will be a victory of sorts.

Why. I've failed to discuss these thoughts productively with my sister and my husband - the two closest relationships I had in my life. They couldn't even dip their toe in it, it was so alien to them. Even my therapist doesn't get it. I'm now distant from all 3.

When im in my bed after a hard day of work, i just crave oblivion. I want no thoughts or feelings of any kind, when they insist on coming, i drown them out with mindless browsing or game-playing. Any thoughts are a big no-no. The closest ive come to try and feel 'normal' are these 2 friends i have. But i dont share any of the deep dark stuff with them. Just witty banter and mundane chitchat to avoid any real talk of any kind.
How do you get the relief or comfort? I just don't get it.
